title: Check text in another language without lang
user_impact: Screen readers read the passage with the page language's pronunciation, which makes it hard to understand.
technical_impact: Heuristic language detection per text block; pages that are neither German nor English stay untested.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.1.2 Language of Parts (not tested)
checks.applicability: Pages with a non-empty lang whose primary subtag is neither de nor en.
checks.expectation:
Marks 3.1.2 as not tested, once at the html element, when the page language is
neither German nor English (including a malformed value such as "en_US" whose
primary subtag is not "en"): passages in other languages cannot be recognised
there, and silence must not read as a pass. On German or English pages nothing
is reported; without a page language the rule does not apply.
